    interior = interior.most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_bounds = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v == background for v in row) > w//2]
    col_bounds = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == background for r in range(h)) > h//2]
    out = []
    for r0,r1 in zip(row_bounds,row_bounds[1:]):

        for c0,c1 in zip(col_bounds,col_bounds[1:]):
            corners = [grid[r0][c0],grid[r0][c1],grid[r1][c0],grid[r1][c1]]
            color = corners[0]
            if color not in (background,interior) and all(v == color for v in corners):
